info.name: Pizza payOS backend
info.description: Local API contract. Supply your Firebase ID token and catalog product ID. Reuse checkoutKey for retries. No live credentials are included. Pricing adds no tax surcharge; delivery costs 22000 VND and is free for pickup or subtotal >= 300000 VND.

request.description: Use an existing Firestore product/variant. Omit variantId for products with no variants. Optional needCutlery is a boolean, saved to the fulfillment order after payment. Keep the key and payload unchanged when retrying.

exec: pm.test('Checkout is persisted with a server total', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const order = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(order.id).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/); pm.expect(order.total).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(order.pricing.tax).to.eql(0); pm.expect(order.pricing.deliveryFee).to.eql(0); pm.expect(order.total).to.eql(order.pricing.subtotal); pm.expect(['PENDING', 'PAID']).to.include(order.paymentStatus); pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId', order.id); });
pm.test('Reads the authenticated owner snapshot', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')); });

request.description: Calls the payOS API; use when the webhook or socket event has been missed.

exec: pm.test('Provider reconciliation returns a snapshot', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('providerStatus'); });
pm.test('Unsigned payment cannot be accepted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
